atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS 4: declares design tokens (colors, fonts, breakpoints, …) as CSS variables that also generate utilities.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS 4: loads a JavaScript plugin (replaces the `plugins` array of the v3 config file).

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS 4: defines a custom variant (e.g. the class-based `dark:` variant).

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS 4: applies a variant's rules inside plain CSS.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS 4: registers a custom utility that works with variants (replaces v3 `@layer utilities` additions).

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: inlines utility classes into custom CSS rules.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS 4: registers extra source files to scan for class names.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS 4: imports a stylesheet for @apply/@variant resolution without emitting its CSS.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS 4: loads a legacy JavaScript config file.
